acceptanceCriteria: Paparazzi setup no longer fails with a missing Compose tooling resource class.
ComposablePreviewScanner discovers a nonzero deterministic production preview set and generated parameterized tests render stable IDs.
Required light/dark, EN/RU, 200 percent font scale and adaptive primary-screen variants are asserted by executable tests.
The record/verify/report commands and expected golden output location are described in the handoff for root-owned execution.
The specialist does not run Gradle, edit the ledger, record goldens or perform the post-golden Lazyweb review; root owns those stages.
goal: Build a deterministic ComposablePreviewScanner plus parameterized Paparazzi suite for the primary light/dark, EN/RU, 200 percent font-scale and adaptive preview matrix; fix the current Paparazzi runtime classpath failure; prepare record/verify commands and inspectable stable screenshot IDs without changing product behavior.
